title: Entangling gate performance and fidelity limits with neutral atom Förster resonances
summary: Neutral-atom entangling gates are commonly analyzed with a single effective Rydberg-pair state, but near Förster resonances the pair manifold contains resonantly coupled interaction channels that change both the control landscape and the achievable fidelity. We develop a two-eigenstate model for this regime and show that when allowing for coupling to both pair states in the resonance, the gate fidelity is bounded by $\mathcal{F}\leq 1-(π/2)/(Vτ_R)$, for interaction strength $V$ and Rydberg lifetime $τ_R$.
